After a night of rain at Al-Hudaibiya the Prophet said Allah declares that whoever credits rain to His blessing believes in Him, and whoever credits a star disbelieves in Him.
One rainy night in the year of al-Hudaybiya, the Prophet relays Allah's word: whoever credits rain to Allah's mercy believes in Him, and whoever credits a star disbelieves in Him.
A believer is like a fresh plant bent by the wind that straightens again after calamities, and a disbeliever like a stiff pine that stands until Allah cuts it down.
When it rained after the Prophet's invocation, he said Allah declared that some of His slaves had become disbelievers in Him and some believers.
